author: Sepehr Mahmoudian
findings_fixed: The broad no-defect summary now states the bounded audit and later checker failures.
Comment mentions are separated from forbidden proof constructs.
Solver/interpreter trust, exact-source binding and mock/real execution boundaries are explicit.
The PDF Cargo command retains its spaces; the short split proof-hole token was replaced with prose.
Fault-aware Bayes is available when a fault model can be justified or estimated.
limits: Visual review cannot establish mathematics, complete renderer correctness, link safety or deterministic reproduction. The existing exact publication, source and link gates supply their own bounded evidence. Physical print and a separate grayscale render were not reviewed; unchanged design and visible luminance contrast were inspected.
negative_results_preserved: Original checker-failure records and solver outputs remain unchanged. The wrong-target example is source-derived, not presented as a fresh solver run.
review_class: Same-system model visual/source review; not human, institutional or mathematical verification.
successor_review: All36 first-build pages were inspected. Final normal renders changed only cross9/19/20; these were reinspected and all33 other images were byte-identical to those already reviewed. Final high-risk renders were also inspected.
